content.outro: The hearth stands open and cold, and the warden's passage is walked again.
content.premise: The wardens of Coldharbour kept their records behind the great hearth of their hall, and the fire was never let die, so nobody walked in who was not meant to. The fire still burns. The sluice that floods the flue is up in Wardens' Lane, at the head of the stone stair, and whoever turns it will put the fire out and open the way behind the hearth.
content.theme: A stone hall with a broad stair up to a lane under the sky, and a great hearth at the stair's foot that is a door when the fire is out.
content.title: The Hearth Door
